verses.text: A psalm by David. Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to what I’m asking. In your faithfulness and righteousness, come to my aid.
Don’t bring your servant to trial. Nobody alive is righteous in your sight.
The enemy is after my life. He’s crushed me into the ground and made me live in dark places like people long dead.
My spirit caves in under it all. Inside, my heart feels empty.
I remember the old days. I think about everything you’ve done and turn over in my mind what your hands have made.
I stretch my hands out to you. My soul thirsts for you like land cracked and dry. Selah.
Answer me quickly, LORD. My spirit is giving out. Don’t hide your face from me or I’ll be like those going down to the pit.
Let me hear of your faithful love in the morning, because I trust you. Show me the way I should go. I lift my soul up to you.
Rescue me from my enemies, LORD. I’m running to you for shelter.
Teach me to do what you want, because you’re my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me on upright ground.
Bring me back to life, LORD, for the sake of your name. In your righteousness, pull me out of trouble.
In your faithful love, cut off my enemies and put an end to everyone who comes after my life, because I’m your servant.
